observation.command:
cd /workspace
ok=0; bad=""
for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18008 18009 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18021 18022 18024; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:$p/docs 2>/dev/null); if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else bad="$bad $p=$code"; fi; done
f=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 5 http://localhost:3002/app/ 2>/dev/null)
echo "backend services ready: $ok/20  not-ready:$bad"
echo "frontend /app/: $f"
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys, json
from collections import Counter
d = json.load(sys.stdin)['data']
print('process states:', dict(Counter(p['status'] for p in d)))
print('not running (expect only the 3 seed jobs):', [p['name'] for p in d if not p['is_running']])
"
free -h | awk 'NR==2{print "mem:", $3" used", $7" avail"}'
